review_route.rationale: High-risk execution and reuse authority where a forged reuse hit can skip required work and falsely report complete execution.

material_finding.summary: A caller can construct a passed CurrentResult, implement ResultObserver to echo it, construct a matching complete receipt, mint opaque VerifiedReuse through equality-only assessment, and make reconciliation report CompleteExecution without executing a check or reading an independently anchored result artifact.
source_evidence: validator/src/routine_work/reuse/receipt.rs:53-68 permits caller construction of complete reuse evidence
validator/src/routine_work/reuse/decision.rs:7-48 validates only equality between caller-controlled values
validator/src/routine_work/report.rs:128-154 reports complete execution without an opaque executed-work witness
material_finding.contract_impact: Verified reuse and complete-execution reporting are false-passable, so the internal HCT-IMPACT/routine kernel cannot be accepted and repeat-use work cannot be skipped safely.

required_correction: make executed-result and observation evidence opaque and issue it only from a concrete trusted capture or anchored-artifact boundary
bind evidence to the exact context candidate root configuration plan check scope tool input and result identities
remove caller-implemented observation and caller-authored complete-receipt authority
require an opaque executed-work witness for executed report rows and opaque VerifiedReuse for reused rows
reject unknown duplicate stale tampered wrong-scope wrong-candidate wrong-tool wrong-input missing and substituted evidence
reproduce the external false-pass probe and prove it fails to compile or is rejected without hidden writes

review_verification.command: focused local_capture security reuse and planning suites

review_verification.result: exit 0 with pre-existing library warnings and two candidate style warnings

highest_defensible_ceiling: The exact candidate identity, structural suites, and exercised filesystem rejection mechanics are supported; verified reuse and truthful complete-execution reporting are withheld.
explicitly_withheld: public routine APIs and command integration
readiness release contract-node closure or goal completion
